summary.ru: Формулы, случаи употребления, маркеры и типичные ошибки Present Perfect — коротко и по делу.
summary.en: Present Perfect formulas, uses, markers and typical mistakes — short and clear.

body.ru:
(+) have / has + V3
(–) have not / has not + V3
(?) Have / Has + V3?
body.en:
(+) have / has + V3
(–) have not / has not + V3
(?) Have / Has + V3?

body.ru:
• результат важен сейчас
• опыт за всю жизнь
• незаконченный период (today, this week)
• действие длится до сих пор
body.en:
• the result matters now
• experience in a lifetime
• an unfinished period (today, this week)
• an action continuing up to now

examples: I have read two books this week.

body.ru:
• just / already / yet
• ever / never
• since / for
• so far / recently
body.en:
• just / already / yet
• ever / never
• since / for
• so far / recently

body.ru:
• I have went → I have gone
• She has wrote → She has written
• We have met him yesterday → We met him yesterday
body.en:
• I have went → I have gone
• She has wrote → She has written
• We have met him yesterday → We met him yesterday

questions.sentence: I ___ already finished my homework.

explanation.ru: С подлежащим I в Present Perfect используется have + причастие finished.
explanation.en: With the subject I, Present Perfect uses have + the participle finished.

questions.sentence: She ___ lived here since 2019.

explanation.ru: Подлежащее she требует has; since 2019 — точка отсчёта.
explanation.en: The subject she requires has; since 2019 marks the starting point.

questions.sentence: They ___ never been to London.

translation.ru: Они никогда не были в Лондоне.

explanation.ru: Опыт с never: have + been; подлежащее they требует have.
explanation.en: Experience with never: have + been; the subject they requires have.

questions.sentence: ___ you ever eaten sushi?

explanation.ru: Вопрос об опыте: Have + подлежащее you + ever + причастие eaten.
explanation.en: A question about experience: Have + the subject you + ever + the participle eaten.

questions.sentence: He ___ just left the office.

translation.ru: Он только что вышел из офиса.

explanation.ru: Just и подлежащее he требуют has + причастие left.
explanation.en: Just and the subject he require has + the participle left.

questions.sentence: We ___ not seen that film yet.

translation.ru: Мы ещё не видели тот фильм.

explanation.ru: Отрицание с we: have not + причастие seen; yet ставится в конце.
explanation.en: The negative with we: have not + the participle seen; yet comes at the end.

questions.sentence: I have ___ my keys, so I cannot open the door.

translation.ru: Я потерял ключи, поэтому не могу открыть дверь.

explanation.ru: После have нужно причастие прошедшего времени: lose → lost.
explanation.en: After have the past participle is needed: lose → lost.

questions.sentence: She has ___ in many countries.

explanation.ru: После has нужна форма причастия: regular verb travel → travelled.
explanation.en: After has the participle form is needed: the regular verb travel → travelled.

questions.sentence: He has not finished his homework ___.

translation.ru: Он ещё не закончил домашнее задание.

explanation.ru: Yet ставится в конце отрицательного предложения в Present Perfect.
explanation.en: Yet goes at the end of a negative Present Perfect sentence.

questions.sentence: He has ___ arrived, so we can start.

translation.ru: Он только что приехал, так что можем начинать.

explanation.ru: Just — «только что» — ставится между have/has и причастием.
explanation.en: Just means a very short time ago and goes between have/has and the participle.

questions.sentence: I have lived here ___ five years.

explanation.ru: For + длительность (five years) с Present Perfect.
explanation.en: For + a length of time (five years) with Present Perfect.

questions.sentence: She has worked here ___ 2020.

explanation.ru: Since + точка отсчёта (2020) с Present Perfect.
explanation.en: Since + a starting point (2020) with Present Perfect.

questions.sentence: I have not seen him ___ Monday.

translation.ru: Я не видел его с понедельника.

explanation.ru: Since + конкретный день (Monday), от которого ведётся отсчёт.
explanation.en: Since + a particular day (Monday), the point from which we count.

questions.sentence: We have known each other ___ ten years.

translation.ru: Мы знакомы друг с другом десять лет.

explanation.ru: For + длительность (ten years) с Present Perfect.
explanation.en: For + a length of time (ten years) with Present Perfect.

questions.sentence: I have ___ this film three times.

translation.ru: Я смотрел этот фильм три раза.

explanation.ru: После have нужно причастие: see → seen.
explanation.en: After have the participle is needed: see → seen.

questions.sentence: Have you ever ___ to Paris?

explanation.ru: Опыт поездки с возвращением передаёт been: have been to Paris.
explanation.en: Experience of a trip and return is expressed with been: have been to Paris.

questions.sentence: She has ___ to the shops, so she is not at home.

translation.ru: Она ушла в магазин, поэтому её нет дома.

explanation.ru: Gone значит «уехал и ещё там», поэтому её нет дома.
explanation.en: Gone means went and is still away, so she is not at home.

questions.sentence: I ___ my homework yet.

translation.ru: Я ещё не сделал домашнее задание.

explanation.ru: Yet в конце предложения требует Present Perfect: have not finished.
explanation.en: Yet at the end of the sentence requires Present Perfect: have not finished.

questions.sentence: We ___ each other for twenty years, and we are still friends.

translation.ru: Мы знаем друг друга двадцать лет, и мы до сих пор друзья.

explanation.ru: And we are still friends показывает, что период продолжается, поэтому нужен Present Perfect: have known.
explanation.en: And we are still friends shows that the period continues, so the Present Perfect is needed: have known.

questions.sentence: This is the first time I ___ this song.

explanation.ru: После оборота this is the first time используется Present Perfect: have heard.
explanation.en: After this is the first time, Present Perfect is used: have heard.

explanation.ru: Present Perfect: has + причастие finished; подлежащее she требует has.
explanation.en: Present Perfect: has + the participle finished; the subject she requires has.

translation.ru: Они ещё не видели новый фильм.

explanation.ru: Отрицание: have not + причастие seen; yet стоит в конце.
explanation.en: The negative: have not + the participle seen; yet comes at the end.

explanation.ru: Вопрос об опыте: Have + подлежащее + ever + причастие been.
explanation.en: An experience question: Have + subject + ever + the participle been.

explanation.ru: For + длительность (three years) с Present Perfect.
explanation.en: For + a length of time (three years) with Present Perfect.

translation.ru: Я живу в этом городе с 2018 года.

explanation.ru: Since + точка отсчёта (2018) с Present Perfect.
explanation.en: Since + a starting point (2018) with Present Perfect.

prompt.ru: Сопоставьте форму Present Perfect и пример.
prompt.en: Match each Present Perfect form with the example.

pairs.right: She has finished the report.
They have not arrived yet.
Have you seen this film?
Yes, I have.

explanation.ru: Present Perfect строится с have/has и причастием; отрицание и вопрос используют have/has.
explanation.en: Present Perfect is built with have/has and the participle; the negative and the question use have/has.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with the example.

pairs.right: He has broken his glasses, so he cannot read.
He has travelled to many countries.
She has written three emails today.
The film has just started.

explanation.ru: Present Perfect связывает прошлое с настоящим: результат, опыт, незаконченный период и только что завершённое действие.
explanation.en: Present Perfect links the past with the present: a result, experience, an unfinished period and a just-finished action.

prompt.en: Match each time marker with the example.

pairs.right: The postman has just delivered a parcel.
He has already washed the car.
The film has not begun yet.
Has she ever worked abroad?

explanation.ru: Маркеры just, already, yet и ever входят в Present Perfect и показывают связь с настоящим.
explanation.en: The markers just, already, yet and ever belong to Present Perfect and show a link with the present.

prompt.en: Match each for/since rule with the example.

pairs.right: They have been friends for years.
She has studied English since September.
He has not started his new job yet.
Nothing has changed since Monday.

explanation.ru: For называет длительность, since — точку отсчёта; оба предлога типичны для Present Perfect.
explanation.en: For names a length of time and since names a starting point; both are typical of Present Perfect.

prompt.en: Match each rule with the example.

pairs.right: He has been to Africa before.

left.en: gone — went and is still away

pairs.right: They have gone to the station.
This is the first time she has flown.
We visited them last week.

explanation.ru: Been означает, что человек побывал и вернулся; gone — что он уехал и ещё там; с законченным временем нужен Past Simple.
explanation.en: Been means the person went and came back; gone means they went and are still away; finished time takes Past Simple.

explanation.en: The formula is have/has + V3; the negative adds not and the question begins with Have/Has.
